# LoadedCookBook

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Formats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public class LoadedCookBook : IDisposable
```

Owns its recipes, which own their ingredients, which own the variant images — so `using var book = CookBookArchive.Read(path)` frees the whole tree. Reading an archive pulls every variant PNG into memory, so a caller that opens books repeatedly (a GUI) must dispose each one.

### SourceSha256 { #p-sourcesha256 }

```csharp
public string? SourceSha256 { get; init; }
```

SHA-256 of the `.cbk` this was read from, recorded into a generated Set so an output can be traced back to the exact archive that produced it. Null for a book that never came from a file (built in memory, or still unsaved in an editor).
